opener_concept: Squash jug: 4 scoops in 2 litres. Student answers scoops-per-litre (concentration = amount/volume) then scoops in half a litre (moles = concentration x volume) by pure common sense, before the reveal names c = n/V and n = cV, and the cm3-to-dm3 habit.
